objective: A frozen exploratory census on the 3 x 3 tube: classify every failing stage at the second doubling (g = 2, 3, 4; P = 1 to 24) as internal (a ring's parts on its own cells alone fail) or heard (they bind, and parts held by other rings cancel them), with crossing; search schedules of uneven runs at g = 3 (and g = 2, 5) for ones that cross a border with every stage balanced; confirm the balanced ones at 48 x 48 with BIRTH-RULE-20261109-001A-E001's full-state reading, and one size past at 96 x 96.
title: Schedules that cross a border, and why stages fail
